from pathlib import Path
import json
base=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
items=[('1791193355-a2751a10ad07','DEV-PRED-REPAIR-VERIFY-CURRENT-20261005'),('1791193375-fab944ada4fa','DEV-PRED-PROD-SYNC-EXACT-CURRENT-20261005'),('1791193689-fa1468ea6bf0','DEV-PRED-PROD-SYNC-REPAIR-CURRENT-20261005')]
for event,task in items:
    msg=''
    loc=''
    for d in ('sent','inflight','outbox'):
        p=base/d/(event+'.json')
        if p.is_file():
            obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'))
            msg=str(obj.get('message') or '')
            loc=str(p)
            break
    hit=''
    for line in msg.splitlines():
        if 'NIGHTSHIFT_WSL_RESULT_V1' in line and ('task='+task) in line:
            hit=line.strip()
            break
    print('RECOVER task='+task+' event='+event+' line='+(hit[:1600] if hit else 'NOT_FOUND')+' file='+loc,flush=True)
